nodes.label: Nursing Timer Card
nodes.rationale: Carries data-feed-id, data-side, data-started-at and data-server-now on the root so static/js/timer.js can tick locally from the server clock without polling; start/switch/stop all hx-target #timer-card so the card is always replaced as one unit and cached/offline hints stay inside it.

nodes.label: Feed Lifecycle HTMX Endpoints
nodes.rationale: POST /feeds starts a side, POST /feeds/{id}/switch flips side and POST /feeds/{id}/stop closes the feed; all three return the timer card plus out-of-band status/last-nursed/sleep/timeline fragments so one tap refreshes every derived view.
